name: Aviation
author: Sixth Front
description: A battle type: pick AVIATION on the main menu. An air war over Highlands, a map about six times the size of the normal one (3 km across). Everyone flies: the Jets and Bombers mods (switched on for you) with up to 10 aircraft a side. The five objectives are sky zones: fly through one to take it, and bomb a zone the enemy holds to knock it back to neutral.

battle.name: AVIATION
battle.tagline: Highlands, three kilometres of mountains and valleys. Everyone flies: take the sky zones by flying through them, bomb the ones the enemy holds, and keep their fighters off your bombers.

script: // A battle mod turns the match into a vehicle battle: every soldier (you and the bots) deploys straight into
// a vehicle, and the deploy screen only offers places where vehicles can join the fight.
const g = api.game, pc = g.playerCtl, hud = g.hud, ui = g.ui, world = g.world;
const { HQS, TEAMS, RULES, VEHICLES } = api.config;
const clamp = (v, a, b) => (v < a ? a : v > b ? b : v);
const rand = (a, b) => a + Math.random() * (b - a);
const lerp = (a, b, t) => a + (b - a) * t;
const h = api.addModel([{ shape: 'box', size: [0.01, 0.01, 0.01] }], { x: 0, y: -500, z: 0 });
// Replaces a method and remembers how to put the old one back
undo.push(() => { if (obj[name] === fn) { if (own) obj[name] = prev; else delete obj[name]; } });
onOff(() => { for (const u of undo.splice(0).reverse()) { try { u(); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } } });
const MAPSIZE = api.mapSize ? api.mapSize() : { play: 240, world: 560 };
const surface = (x, z) => { const h = world.heightAt(x, z); return SEA !== null && SEA > h ? SEA : h; };
// how many vehicles each side gets: one per soldier, up to a cap
// (the same on every page, so online games agree on the list of vehicles)
// The place a bot rejoins the fight: usually the held flag closest to the enemy, otherwise its HQ
for (const f of g.mode.flags) if (f.owner !== team) d = Math.min(d, Math.hypot(f.x - p.x, f.z - p.z));
if (d < bd) { bd = d; pt = p; }
// B: { noun, plural, free(team) -> vehicles ready to take, keep(point) -> deploy points shown,
//      board(soldier, vehicle, point) -> put the soldier in the vehicle at that point, pickFor(point) -> the player's vehicle }
// People (you, and other players in an online game) on a side who are waiting to deploy
const humansWaiting = (team) => (g.state === 'menu' ? 0 : g.soldiers.filter((s) => (s.isPlayer || (s.mp && s.mp.player)) && s.team === team && s.state !== 'alive' && s.state !== 'downed').length);
// the bots leave a vehicle for each person on their side who is choosing where to deploy
if (forPlayer && B.label) for (const p of pts) B.label(p, team);
// bots respawn straight into a free vehicle, or wait for one
// the Multiplayer mod asks which vehicle you'd get (to claim it from the host first), then deploys with it
const pick = (point, skip) => (B.pickFor ? B.pickFor(point, skip) : readyFor(g.player.team, false, skip)[0]) || null;
if (P.state === 'alive' && P.vehicle !== v) B.board(P, v, point);
// the deploy button waits while no vehicle is ready
// Air war over a huge map. Everyone flies: the jets and bombers from the Jets and Bombers mods, more of them
// than in a normal battle. The objectives are sky zones, tall cylinders of airspace: fly through one to take
// it, bomb an enemy zone to knock it back toward neutral.
if (!A) throw new Error('Aviation needs the Jets and Bombers mods (they are switched on when you pick AVIATION on the main menu)');
// the air core boards bots by itself in normal battles; here this mod decides who flies what
if (prevMaxBots === undefined) delete A.maxBots; else A.maxBots = prevMaxBots;
for (const a of A.fleet) delete a.spare;
for (const a of added) if (A.fleet.includes(a)) A.removeAircraft(a);
// One aircraft per soldier (up to 10 a side): about one bomber in five, the rest spread over the jets
const jets = types.filter((t) => t.kind !== 'bomber'), bombers = types.filter((t) => t.kind === 'bomber');
const nb = bombers.length ? Math.max(1, Math.round(want / 5)) : 0, nj = want - nb;
jets.forEach((t, i) => plan.set(t, Math.floor(nj / jets.length) + (i < nj % jets.length ? 1 : 0)));
bombers.forEach((t, i) => plan.set(t, Math.floor(nb / bombers.length) + (i < nb % bombers.length ? 1 : 0)));
let have = A.fleet.filter((a) => a.type === t && a.team === team);
for (let i = have.length; i < n; i++) added.push(A.addAircraft(t, team));
have = A.fleet.filter((a) => a.type === t && a.team === team);
have.forEach((a, i) => { a.spare = i >= Math.max(1, n); });
if (s === g.player) { pc.camYaw = a.yaw; pc.camPitch = a.pitch; A.helpT = 9; }
pickFor: (pt) => (pt && pt.type === 'air' && pt.air && ready(pt.air) ? pt.air : null),
const list = A.fleet.filter((a) => a.team === s.team && ready(a));
// leave one for you on your side while you choose
const sel = g.ui.selectedPoint && g.state === 'deploy' ? g.ui.selectedPoint() : null;
const keepFor = sel && sel.air ? sel.air : list[0];
if (list.length <= humansWaiting(s.team) - (P && P.team === s.team && P.state !== 'alive' ? 1 : 0)) { s.respawnT = rand(1, 2.5); return; }
// fill gaps: whichever kind this side has fewest of in the air
const flying = (k) => A.fleet.filter((a) => a.team === s.team && a.kind === k && a.flying).length;
// shot-down aircraft are back on the line in ten seconds instead of half a minute
api.on('tick', () => { for (const a of A.fleet) if (!a.alive && a.respawnT > 10) a.respawnT = 10; });
for (const z of zoneVis) { g.scene.remove(z.group); z.group.traverse((o) => { if (o.geometry) o.geometry.dispose(); if (o.material) o.material.dispose(); }); }
const beamMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: NEUTRAL.clone(), transparent: true, opacity: 0.32, depthWrite: false, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, side: THREE.DoubleSide });
const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(3, 3, h, 10, 1, true), beamMat);
const ringMat = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: NEUTRAL.clone(), transparent: true, opacity: 0.55, depthWrite: false });
const ring = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(f.radius, 1.6, 4, 120), ringMat);
const target = f.owner >= 0 ? new THREE.Color(TEAMS[f.owner].hex) : NEUTRAL;
// Bombs, rockets and missiles that land inside a zone you don't hold knock it toward your side
patch(g.combat, 'explode', (prev) => function (x, y, z, def, owner) {
prev.call(this, x, y, z, def, owner);
if (f.owner === owner.team || Math.hypot(x - f.x, z - f.z) > f.radius || y > f.y + 80) continue;
// Bot pilots: fighters go after the zones (taking or holding them); attackers and bombers bomb enemy zones
let sc = ai.zonePref[i] - Math.hypot(f.x - v.pos.x, f.z - v.pos.z) / 30;
if (sc > bs) { bs = sc; best = f; }
ai.cx = best.x; ai.cz = best.z; ai.r = clamp(v.speed * 2.2, 140, best.radius * 0.8);
// Bailing out over a map this size is a long walk: say how to get back in the air
if (e.soldier === g.player && e.vehicle.isAircraft && g.state === 'playing') api.toast(g.isTouch ? 'PAUSE → REDEPLOY TO FLY AGAIN' : 'ESC → REDEPLOY TO FLY AGAIN');
